However, the 'HelloWorldApp.csproj' file is not present among the files associated with the 'HelloWorldApp' project. The dataset includes 11 other files such as 'Helper.cs', 'Worker_test.cs', and 'Program.cs', but none of these are the 'HelloWorldApp.csproj'. Therefore, it is not possible to ascertain the number of project properties defined in the 'HelloWorldApp.csproj' file as it does not exist in the current dataset.
query_history: MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'}) RETURN size(keys(p.config_metadata)) AS propertyCount
MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'}) RETURN CASE WHEN p.config_metadata IS NOT NULL THEN size(keys(p.config_metadata)) ELSE 0 END AS propertyCount
MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'}) RETURN apoc.meta.type(p.config_metadata) AS configMetadataType
MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'}) RETURN size(keys(p.build_properties)) AS buildPropertyCount
MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'}) WHERE exists(p.build_properties) AND apoc.meta.type(p.build_properties) = 'MAP' RETURN size(keys(p.build_properties)) AS buildPropertyCount
MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'}) WHERE p.build_properties IS NOT NULL AND apoc.meta.type(p.build_properties) = 'MAP' RETURN size(keys(p.build_properties)) AS buildPropertyCount
MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'}) WHERE p.build_properties IS NOT NULL RETURN size(keys(p.build_properties)) AS buildPropertyCount

MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'}) WHERE p.build_properties IS NOT NULL RETURN CASE WHEN apoc.meta.type(p.build_properties) = 'LIST' THEN size(p.build_properties) ELSE 0 END AS buildPropertyCount
MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'})-[:CONTAINS]->(f:File {name: 'HelloWorldApp.csproj'}) RETURN size(f.properties) AS numberOfProperties
MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'})-[:CONTAINS]->(f:File {name: 'HelloWorldApp.csproj'}) RETURN size(keys(f)) AS numberOfProperties
MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'})-[:CONTAINS]->(f:File) RETURN f.name, keys(f) AS properties LIMIT 25
MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'})-[:CONTAINS]->(f:File) WHERE f.name = 'HelloWorldApp.csproj' RETURN f.name, keys(f) AS properties LIMIT 25
MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'})-[:CONTAINS]->(f:File) WHERE f.name = 'HelloWorldApp.csproj' RETURN f.name, size(keys(f)) AS numberOfProperties LIMIT 25

MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'}) UNWIND keys(p.config_metadata) AS k1 UNWIND keys(p.build_properties) AS k2 WITH collect(DISTINCT k1) + collect(DISTINCT k2) AS allKeys RETURN size(apoc.coll.toSet(allKeys)) AS totalPropertyCount

MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'}) WHERE exists(p.config_metadata) AND exists(p.build_properties) WITH keys(p.config_metadata) + keys(p.build_properties) AS allKeys RETURN size(apoc.coll.toSet(allKeys)) AS totalPropertyCount

MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'}) WHERE p.config_metadata IS NOT NULL AND p.build_properties IS NOT NULL WITH keys(p.config_metadata) + keys(p.build_properties) AS allKeys RETURN size(apoc.coll.toSet(allKeys)) AS totalPropertyCount

MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'}) WHERE p.config_metadata IS NOT NULL AND p.build_properties IS NOT NULL AND apoc.meta.type(p.config_metadata) = 'MAP' AND apoc.meta.type(p.build_properties) = 'MAP' WITH keys(p.config_metadata) + keys(p.build_properties) AS allKeys RETURN size(apoc.coll.toSet(allKeys)) AS totalPropertyCount

MATCH (p:Project {name: 'HelloWorldApp'}) WHERE apoc.meta.type(p.config_metadata) = 'MAP' OR apoc.meta.type(p.build_properties) = 'MAP' WITH coalesce(keys(p.config_metadata), []) + coalesce(keys(p.build_properties), []) AS allKeys RETURN size(apoc.coll.toSet(allKeys)) AS totalPropertyCount
